narrations.title: Leo's Pompous Roar
narrations.narration: Leo the Lion stood in the heart of the Green-Leaf Jungle, his tight teal vest straining against his belly as he tried to look as fearsome as possible.

narrations.title: Pip's Panic
narrations.narration: Hearing the roar, Pip the Squirrel's fluffy tail flicked frantically as he prepared to escape the perceived danger.

narrations.title: Barnaby's Bright Idea
narrations.narration: While everyone else fled, Barnaby the Rabbit hopped into view, his amber eyes bright behind his orange glasses as he tapped his temple.

narrations.title: The Doubtful Lion
narrations.narration: Leo adjusted his monocle, his brow furrowed in deep annoyance as he began to stomp toward the nearby stone well.

narrations.title: The Owl's Observation
narrations.narration: High above the path, Wise Owl watched the proceedings with a knowing glint in his amber eyes, polishing his glasses as he chuckled.

narrations.title: The Confrontation
narrations.narration: Leo reached the edge of the well and peered down into the dark water, where he saw a plump, familiar-looking lion staring back at him.

narrations.title: The Splash
narrations.narration: With a roar of frustration, Leo lunged forward, jumping into the shallow water with a spectacular splash.

narrations.title: A Lesson Learned
narrations.narration: Barnaby hopped away with a giggle as Leo sat shivering in the well, realizing he had just been out-smarted by his own reflection.
